verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is a general statement that API keys can be managed in the Console. Nothing documents scoping keys to specific permissions, workspaces, models or actions, or issuing least-privilege credentials for an agent. Generic key management is an adjacent capability and earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: Build with the Claude API and manage keys, usage, and billing in the Console.
